title: Build a media picker directly into a page
description: Let a signed-in customer attach screenshots or receipts while submitting an order complaint from a dashboard page.
problem: Customers need to upload screenshots, import a proof URL, and choose an existing attachment without leaving the complaint form in the app.
summary: Use the public media APIs together on a customer dashboard page so complaint attachments, uploads, and library selection all share Dyrected's media pipeline.
runtimeNotes: Client media APIs can target either runtime, while storage ownership differs by runtime.
intents: build a media picker in my app
add upload and media selection to a customer dashboard page
let customers attach screenshots without using the admin modal
